newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline eases back $2, mkt cautious of crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline eases back $2, mkt cautious of crude.

text.p: NWE gasoline slipped about $2 a tonne as the whole energy complex adopted a bearish tone and the arb to the U.S. looked narrow.
Traders said unleaded premium cargoes dropped to $180-182 fob while barges were sold at $183.50 and $184.25. A regular barge sold at $178.50.
Swaps were thinly talked with August sold at $185 and July was pegged at $184.

The Mediterranean, as expected, was showing strength relative to NWE because of Nigerian demand. Traders said Premium unleaded was pegged around $193 cif Med, about $2 stronger than NWE levels. The thin market was attributed to people stepping back from dealing.
"It looks like it (crude) could fall again and people don't want to get caught," said one.
